decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/reply-ep, src=<path label 0:1>, kind=RESULT, VALUE u32=1234 } - the reply a MINTING TERMINUS emits (RFC-0027 6.1 point 3). The residual this node resolved, `/sensor/temp`, is spelled as one 7-byte path-label element instead of the 12 bytes of string it stands for, so the whole `src` IS the label.
decoded.note: The label is the RFC-0018 escape record `00 16 04 <u32 LE>`, index 0 at generation 1 (RFC-0027 5.3.2, amendment 5). A terminus that mints nothing echoes the request's dst as the reply's src unchanged and is fully conformant (6.3).
